text: Struggling for money, Sri, a young woman born on Friday Kliwon, [accepts a generously paid job with the Atmojo family|trigger|saying yes to an offer]. With two other women, Erna and Dini, she is taken to [a hidden hut deep in the forest|images|wild and lonely places], where they must bathe Dela, a granddaughter lying unconscious under [a curse of a thousand days|threat|witchcraft and cursed things]. A mystical agreement binds them to the hut until the ritual is complete on the thousandth day, and [if they break it, they die|rules|break the rule and pay].
